Bright Data

Public-web information with a traceable pipeline.

BDOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Collect approved public-web information using Bright Data's supported scraping and data-access products. MoreSpace can build market watchlists, catalog monitoring, account-research datasets, and source-backed competitor reports around a defined collection scope. We retain source URLs, timestamps, and validation results, then route the cleaned information into your research workspace or warehouse so teams can review changes and judge data quality.

Useful outputs

  • Dated records with source references
  • Validated changes and exception reports
  • A review-ready research dataset

Where we can apply it

  • Approved catalog pages → scheduled collection → change validation → pricing or availability watchlist.
  • Public account sources → company-field collection → analyst review → prospect research workspace.
  • Market source list → dated snapshots → quality checks → competitor intelligence report.
01

Use case 1

Monitor an agreed set of public product or market pages.

02

Use case 2

Collect approved company context for account research.

03

Use case 3

Create dated competitor snapshots for an analyst-reviewed report.

Inputs we need

  • An approved source URL list
  • Required fields and collection cadence
  • Source permissions and quality rules

Delivery sequence

  • Agree on allowed sources, fields, collection limits, and permissions.
  • Configure the supported collection method and preserve provenance for every record.
  • Validate completeness and changes, then publish accepted records to the research workspace.

Expert review points

  • Verify the collection scope and appropriate use of source information.
  • Sample extracted records against original pages before downstream decisions.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • n8n
  • Retool
  • Google BigQuery
  • Custom research pipelines

Signals we can make visible

  • Collection success rate
  • Source coverage
  • Data completeness
  • Dataset freshness

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
